description: This file defines the EntityType interface, representing the type of an entity within the system. It emphasizes immutability and provides static factory methods and accessors.

classes.name: EntityType
classes.description: An immutable interface representing an entity's type; extends Comparable and CharSequence, providing methods for instantiation and string representation.

methods.name: EntityType.of
methods.description: Creates an EntityType instance from a given CharSequence using a factory method in EntityTypes.

methods.name: EntityType.toString
methods.description: Returns the string value representing this entity type.
